build_vllm_config: build a VllmConfig instance with model, cache, parallel, and scheduler configurations for GPU inference
create_vllm_config_hash: create a hash string from a VllmConfig that uniquely identifies computation graph settings
test_optimization_level: test the OptimizationLevel enum to select O0 through O3 optimization levels for vLLM compilation
run_set_current_vllm_config: run set_current_vllm_config context manager to temporarily set the global vLLM config for model initialization
summarize_vllm_config: summarize a VllmConfig instance by calling its __str__ method to display model, parallelism, and compilation settings
